findings.title: Agent-authored mapping assertions claim evidence supplied by a human reviewer
findings.reproduction: For each listed final payload compare ontology_mapping.evidence MANUAL_CURATION against frozen beforeimage and new curation_history. All36 listed new assertions originate from this campaign’s agent authorship, with llm_assisted true; author/peer receipts identify in-process Codex agents, not a human evidence provider. Schema EvidenceTypeEnum explicitly defines MANUAL_CURATION as manually curated evidence supplied by a human reviewer.
findings.bounded_fix: Use the truthful allowed source/decision type for each assertion (e.g. DATABASE_MATCH, LITERATURE, CAS_RN_CROSS_REFERENCE or CURATOR_JUDGMENT as applicable), retain exact primary URL/locator and llm_assisted history; do not fabricate human review or apply blanket LLM_SUGGESTION to directly inspected primary facts. Revalidate exact successor payloads.
findings.scientific_limit: This is a provenance-type defect, not a rejection of the independently supported chemical or stock facts. Existing genuine human annotations are not included.
